_activity: Write it: the Make the Case question
intro: Now you write it. The sentence starter is the same one in your casefile — use it. Getting used to it now is how it becomes automatic in June, when every point on the Regents essay counts.
prompt: Make the Case asked you to explain the historical and geographic circumstances that led to the Industrial Revolution in Great Britain. Write your thesis: answer it in one sentence.
sentence_starter: These were the circumstances that led to the Industrial Revolution: ___.
checklist: Did you answer the question, instead of saying it back?
Did you name a reason, something you could point to in a document?
model_response: These were the circumstances that led to the Industrial Revolution: landowners who enclosed the land and pushed families into the towns, an island rich in coal and ports, and owners with money to put into machines.
